title: Goldberg vs. Brock Lesnar: the comeback rivalry
summary: Goldberg returns to WWE and immediately frustrates Lesnar. The rematch becomes a Universal Championship contest after Goldberg wins the title.

chapters.title: Goldberg shocks Lesnar
chapters.context: The comeback victory leaves Lesnar seeking another match.

chapters.title: Lesnar finally defeats Goldberg
chapters.result: Brock Lesnar wins the Universal Championship from Goldberg.
chapters.context: This WWE return arc is distinct from Goldberg’s earlier WCW undefeated-streak story.
